texts.Events_Agenda_Empty: No tracks or sessions yet. Add a track for each strand of the event, then add its sessions.
texts.Events_Agenda_Intro: The event's sessions by track. Move a session with its menu, or drag its handle, or press Space on the handle and use the arrow keys. Clashes are flagged, never refused.
texts.Events_Agenda_LoadFailed: The agenda could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Agenda_RoomClash: Same room at the same time as {0}
texts.Events_Agenda_SpeakerClash: A speaker is also in {0} at the same time
texts.Events_Agenda_Truncated: Showing the first {0} sessions. Use the Event Sessions reports to see the rest.
texts.Events_Home_EmptyPast: No past events yet. Events show here once they end or are cancelled.
texts.Events_Home_EmptyUpcoming: Nothing coming up. Create an event to start planning it.
texts.Events_Home_Intro: Every event the organization runs. Open one to set up its tickets, agenda and speakers.
texts.Events_Home_LoadFailed: The events could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Home_Truncated: Showing the first {0} events. Use the list views on the Events tab to see the rest.
texts.Events_Repeat_BadDates: Each new date must be after the event's own start. Nothing was saved.
texts.Events_PromoCode_Duplicate: The code {0} is already used for this event. Choose another code, or edit the one already there.
texts.Events_Repeat_Intro: Each new date gets a draft copy of {0}, as long as the event, with its ticket types and tracks, linked to the first event of the series.
texts.Events_Repeat_NoPermission: You do not have access to create events. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Events Staff permission set.
texts.Events_SessionSpeaker_Duplicate: This speaker is already in this session.
texts.Events_Shared_DeleteConfirm: Delete {0}? This cannot be undone here, but it stays in the Recycle Bin for 15 days.
texts.Events_Shared_NotSaved: Nothing was saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Speaker_Duplicate: {0} is already a speaker at this event.
texts.Events_Speakers_Empty: No speakers yet. Pick a person above to add them as a speaker.
texts.Events_Speakers_Intro: The people speaking at this event. Pick a person to add them, then use their menu to put them in sessions or fill in their bio and needs.
texts.Events_Speakers_LoadFailed: The speakers could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Speakers_RemoveConfirm: Remove {0} as a speaker? They are taken out of their sessions too. The person stays in BarnCRM.
texts.Events_Tickets_Intro: The kinds of ticket this event offers and the codes that give a discount. BarnCRM records prices and takes no payments.
texts.Events_Tickets_LoadFailed: The tickets could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Tickets_NoCodes: No promo codes. Add one to give a discount on this event's tickets.
texts.Events_Tickets_NoTickets: No ticket types yet. Add one, such as General or Student, with its price.
texts.Events_Tickets_OverCapacity: The ticket quantities add up to {0}, more than the event's capacity of {1}. That is allowed, since not every ticket sells, but check it is what you want.
